entries.title: Total Seven essays read Today and Tomorrow
24 comes with Dilemma here and there
entries.text:
This poor fellow is me.

Today I turned 24

( 23rd October 2003) I don't realise I have turned this much bigger, responsibilities are running. My parents are increasingly worried Abt my education and idk what should I do.

My options: Grind for CAT superr hard and hope it may change any outcome.

Alternative work for XAT and even if not planned Govt Bank examinations are your last destination.

It shouldn't be like this I wanna get free I wanna work where I bring certain value proposition which are increasingly looking bleak to me; it's not that I have no work; I am getting many jobs which I don't wanna do, I don't wanna work hard away from my family without any holiday in Retail brushing my ass hard.

Which raises even further doubts on my capabilities 

What am I good at fucking nothing, I can't keep my focus I have ADHD not officially but atleast what I know my attention span is shorter and shorter, I am delaying many of the decisions day after day after day.

I wanna earn happiness and wealth enough that I don't have to worry Abt day to day chores, the ideal destination is make a company and take a good exit but... Even is this a goal or mere fantasy I don't fucking know.. Why bcoz i haven't been outside home much. I have been noting but the tamed/ domesticated since my childhood and for that I can't blame my parents the have done their best 

Finances have their own problem. Why do I chase them , why can't we all just keep it distant from our life, why is money and materialistic gains in the world pure us 

 Will see where this goes but I don't wanna blast you with so so so many things that you not need to know bcoz I try to keep my life very private and don't enjoy much sharing it public.

Till then let's hope all gets sorted 
Ciao
